scope: Complete native observer dispatcher with synthetic callback and memmove services; callback order/arguments/active flag, final record bytes/count, TLS flags and removal order match
coverage: Deferred cleanup on/off and retained inactive tails
Callback disables a later entry and appends an entry visited in the same dispatch
limits: Native callback bodies and memmove implementation replaced by supplied services
Registry replacement covered by independent tests only
Serial normal-return behavior; no concurrency, lifetime or reentrancy safety claim
